derived_from: the 15 names on the Signal Scorecard + Signal Highlights panels (NVDA sits in both), analysed 2026-10-06
core_thesis: AI infrastructure is the spine of the book: power, compute, memory, networking, cloud. Every other slot must be either AI-leveraged or a defensible niche leader. Picks-and-shovels beat AI-software narratives.
hard_rules: Incumbents are grandfathered: a name already on a panel may stay even if it has no curated moat file (GEV is the live example).
New candidates must have a curated moat file in data/moat-*.json — we only promote names we have actually rated.
Real revenue only. No pre-revenue names. Unprofitable is allowed when it is hyperscale or strategic (CRWV precedent: -$1.93B net income, still on the panel).
Revenue floor: roughly $300M TTM. No micro-caps.
Analyst coverage required, consensus Buy or better.
Diversity is a stated goal: no cluster may exceed its target by more than 1, so the panels cannot collapse into five semiconductor names.

moat.note: Wide=25, Narrow=16, None=6; from the curated moat-*.json rating. Absent file = 10 for incumbents, disqualified for new names.

theme_fit.note: 20 if the name sits in a cluster at or under target, 10 if the cluster is already full, 0 if it is unknown to every cluster.

growth.note: min(rev_growth_yoy * 0.5, 20); negative growth scores 0 and is a red flag.

profitability.note: 15 if net income positive, 6 if negative but revenue > $1B (hyperscale tolerance), 0 otherwise.

valuation.note: 10 if P/E under 25, 6 under 40, 3 under 80, 0 above or N/A.

coverage.note: min(buy_count * 0.5, 10) from the analyst breakdown; 0 sells weighted as a plus.

churn_rule.summary: A rolling rotation. Each bi-weekly cycle targets three refreshed names, not a token one.
swap_when: excluded by policy (see exclusions) — always removed
profile score falls below the floor (55) and a challenger beats it by the margin (8)
otherwise, up to the per-cycle target: the weakest incumbents are replaced by the strongest eligible challengers whenever the challenger outscores them by at least min_uplift (3)
churn_rule.note: The cycle target is 3 swaps. If fewer than 3 candidates clear min_uplift the curator stops early and reports a smaller diff — quality still outranks hitting the number.

highlights.order: detail-card panel; prefer names with the largest analyst coverage and a clean fair-value upside

review_gate: A proposal is never applied automatically. The bi-weekly job delivers the proposal to Telegram; a human approves before tickers are written and the homepage is rebuilt. Nothing on the homepage changes without that approval.

exclusions.reason: Standing instruction: CRWV has no strong moat. Taken off the panels 2026-10-06; may return only with a corrected moat rating and a fresh justification.
